title: Singapore proposes 100% reserves and a ban on yields for stablecoin issuers
summary: The country’s financial watchdog says its proposed stablecoin rules are aligned with U.S. and EU frameworks and that it also paves the way for the recognition of foreign stablecoin.

title: Bitcoin consolidates near $78,000 as Arbitrum surges 30% on Robinhood Chain revenue
summary: BTC drifted lower after last week's rally to $81,428, while ARB led DeFi gains as Robinhood Chain's daily fees topped $2 million.

title: Strategy spends $635M buying back STRC as perpetual preferred stock lags $100 par
summary: STRC trades at $97.34 despite Strategy’s growing repurchases, while SATA’s higher dividend rate has helped it hold its $100 par value.

title: Live updates: Bitcoin trades around $78,000 as global bond sell-off deepens
summary: The bitcoin funds took $217 million Monday, one session after an outflow ended their nine-day run. Ether ETFs have not posted a red day since mid-August.

title: London Stock Exchange to work with Payward to bring biggest UK stocks onchain
summary: The LSE is working with Kraken owner Payward, the developer of the xStocks tokenized equities framework, to bring top U.K.-listed stocks onchain.
